articles.summary: New immune data from the phase 2 trial with EVX-01 to be presented both in an oral and poster presentation New data follows from the three-year clinical update for EVX-01 to be provided at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) 2026 congress on October 24, 2026 COPENHAGEN, Denmark,
articles.title: Evaxion will present new immune data for personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting
